name: DENC46Diagnostic
title: DEN.C4-6 Diagnostic
description: Questionnaire for the DEN.C4-6 diagnostic activities, based on the DEN.C4-6 data dictionary.

text.div:
Implementation notes and pending items

Pending decisions and terminology checks for DEN.C4-6 Diagnostic:

  • Suspected/confirmed Boolean to Condition mapping: the questionnaire preserves the optional Yes/No answers as Boolean QuestionnaireResponse answers. A Boolean answer alone does not determine whether a Condition should be created or whether its verificationStatus should be provisional, unconfirmed, confirmed, or refuted. Define the clinical workflow before deriving Conditions from these answers.
  • DEN.C4.DE1 pop-up note: the source lists conditions that mimic febrile or critical dengue phases, but does not define which phase triggers the pop-up or whether these are informational text or selectable diagnoses. The note is retained in the traceability matrix; no answer options or trigger rules were invented.
  • DEN.C6 decision-support linkage: the source links classification to “Classify the patient” but provides no executable criteria in this worksheet. The questionnaire records a required single selection and does not calculate a group.
  • DEN.C4 ICD mappings: the source assigns the same ICD-11 code 1D2Z and ICD-10 code A97.9 to suspected and confirmed dengue despite their different meanings; validate these candidate mappings.
  • Terminology candidates: source codes are recorded in ConceptMaps as related candidate mappings; they have not been independently validated. The source repeats Group A codes for Group B and Group C SNOMED code 722863008 for Group D. These conflicts remain unresolved; no replacement was inferred.
  • Terminologies not classifiable: the worksheet marks all DEN.C4-6 concepts as not classifiable in LOINC and ICF. ConceptMaps contain no target codes for these systems.
  • OpenMRS columns: the supplied OpenMRS entities and IDs refer to unrelated obstetric/anatomical concepts such as amniotic fluid, placenta, and fetal position. They were excluded from the dengue model and should be corrected in the source.
  • Condition representation: the secondary mapping workbook proposes BR-Core Condition for clinical diagnoses and classification. Raw Boolean answers remain in QuestionnaireResponse because Condition alone cannot preserve explicit No answers.
  • External terminology validation: ICD-11, ICD-10, and SNOMED CT codes require terminology-server validation. The source provides no LOINC or ICF target code.
